statements.status_notes: PingFederate is not affected by this vulnerability on the releases in question. PingFederate 13.1.3 and later ship jackson-databind 2.21.1, which is far above the 2.13.0 threshold and includes modern stream-constraint protections such as nesting-depth and document-length limits. Customers running very old maintenance releases with jackson-databind 2.12.x should upgrade to a current release, which resolves this alongside many other dependency updates.
